# Icons and Logos

The icon sets, their sizes and colours, and how the Qualys logo and other companies' logos are used. The Icon component, its library and the logo and icon files are at the end of this guide.

## Iconography

### Custom SVG icons

![The same search icon in charcoal on a light tile, white on a dark tile and blue for interactive use.](data:image/webp;base64,)

Inline SVG icons, monochrome, drawn in `currentColor`: the Qualys utility icons and, for everything else, Hugeicons (free, stroke rounded). No icon font. Use the `Icon` component. UI icons come in five sizes, each with its own stroke weight: xs 12px, sm 16px (default), md 20px, lg 24px, xl 32px; colours are black (`icon-default`), blue (`icon-feature`) or white (`icon-inverted`). Feature Icons and the General icons are illustrations and sit outside that scale.

### Utility icons

![The 25 utility icons in a grid, from download and arrows to the status icons.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**Utility icons** (this system): download, arrow-right / arrow-left, outlink, search, check, filter, menu, time, chevrons in four directions, plus, cross, the calendar's three view icons (list, month, grid), and the status set for dialogs and notifications (alert-triangle, alert-circle, check-circle, x-circle, file, party, cookie). 16px in buttons, text links and fields, with a 4px gap from button labels.

### Event icons

![The five event types, each icon beside its label: Qualys Event, Webinar, Industry Event, Speaking Engagement, Training.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**Event icons** (this system, Event Icons group and `event-*` in Icon): Qualys Event, Webinar, Industry Event, Speaking Engagement, Training — 24px, each in its own colour, always beside its label (EventType).

### General icons

![The three general line icons in white on Charcoal: Events, Webinar, Resource.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**General icons** (this system, General Icons group and `general-*` in Icon): Events, Webinar, Resource — 56 × 43 line icons in `icon-inverted` on the Charcoal hub promo cards.

### Social icons

![The three social icon sizes: 24px in the 52px blue button, 15px in plain rows, 25px in Rhino in the footer.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**Social icons** (this system, Social Icons group and `social-*` in Icon): LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, Vimeo, YouTube and URL — 24px in the 52px blue SocialButton, 16px in `text-secondary` for plain rows, 24px in Rhino in the footer. They are the networks' own marks: use them as supplied, and only to link to that network.

### Feature icons

![Four two-tone blue feature icons at 56px for cards, and one at 32px beside a drawer title.](data:image/webp;base64,)

**Feature icons** (this system, Feature Icons group): 19 two-tone blue illustrations — AI, Agentic AI, Application, Applications, Assets, Cloud, Communication, Compliance, Configure, Detect, Eliminate, Measure, Prioritize, Remediation, Response, Risk, Threat, Vulnerability, Web Application. They keep their own colours; show them at 32px beside a Drawer title, 56px on a Card, never recoloured. **Social icons** live in the Figma file.

### Link icons

![Three icons and their meaning: outlink on a link that leaves qualys.com, arrow-right on a link that stays, download on a download button.](data:image/webp;base64,)

`outlink` marks links that leave qualys.com; `arrow-right` marks links that stay; `download` leads download buttons.

## Logo

### Colour versions

![The logo three ways: full colour on white, all white on Charcoal, and reversed with a red shield and white wordmark on the blue gradient.](data:image/webp;base64,)

Use the full-colour logo (`qualys-logo-full-rgb.svg`: Qualys Red shield, charcoal wordmark) on white and warm off-white. On charcoal or blue grounds render it all-white (`filter: brightness(0) invert(1)`); inline promo cards use the reversed logo instead (`qualys-logo-reversed.svg`: red shield, white wordmark).

### The shield

![The shield alone in a square tile. Do: use it for square or tight spaces. Do not: redraw, recolour or re-letter the mark.](data:image/webp;base64,)

The shield alone (`qualys-shield.svg`) is for square or tight spaces. Never redraw, recolour or re-letter the mark.

### Sizes

![The logo at 37px high for the Nav, and the shield at 75px wide for the footer.](data:image/webp;base64,)

Nav logo height 37px. The footer shows the shield alone, 75px wide (39px on mobile), in its notch.

### Customer, partner and sponsor logos

![Four neutral placeholders of equal size on white. Do: each company's own file on a clear ground at a similar size. Do not: redrawn, recoloured or cropped logos.](data:image/webp;base64,)

Use each company's own logo file as it supplies it, on a clear ground, at a similar visual size to its neighbours and with the company name as its text alternative. Never redraw, recolour or crop one. The previews in this system use neutral placeholders.
